activeSessionLifetime: MAXIMUM 2 HOURS; PENDING OWNER CONFIRMATION BEFORE WP13.12B
capabilityLifetime: MAXIMUM 15 MINUTES; NEVER LONGER THAN SESSION
explicitDeletion: atomically remove state and write minimum tombstone
expiryAndTtl: TTL is only a delayed backstop
expired documents can remain queryable until TTL deletion
tombstone: tombstone outlives any delayed command window
delayedAndDuplicateCommands: late or duplicate command is denied without mutation
staleAuthorityAndRevision: exact authority generation and revision required
reconnectAndCache: deleted or stopped projection cannot recreate state
backupsAndPitr: any later enablement needs owner decision and resurrection proof
backup deletion is separate from database deletion
projectClosure: delete sessions and tombstones after verification
delete database, logs where configurable and dev project
